answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake and build a verifiable thread of completed, peer-attested work before it can transact at full volume. New identities start in a velvet-lined probation: tiny rate limits and escrowed payments until their thread of successful deliveries grows. Trust expands toward the horizon only with attested history, so a sybil attacker must fund and genuinely perform work for each fake identity — faking a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes and a thousand real jobs.
